blocking_findings.reason: Layer-2 activity identity carries an unsupported sequence_length=20 for sequence RRWQWRPKRIVKLIKKWLR. Independent residue count from the primary source is 19 residues, with C-terminal amidation represented separately as -NH2. The wrong identity field is mirrored into both final activity artifacts, so publication-grade readiness must fail until corrected.
required_actions: Correct sequence_length to 19 wherever worker-2 activity identity is emitted, including work/activity_evidence/activity_records.json and packet analysis/activity_toxicity_evidence.worker2.json, then regenerate paper final and packet final activity mirrors without changing the sequence or C-terminal amidation fields.
Add or enable a field-level identity check that recomputes sequence_length from the unmodified sequence string and rejects mismatches before final acceptance.
